Serwaa sets aside time with the Ugly-Eyes flesh. Look, smell, touch — then the smallest taste, and wait. An hour passes. Calm stomach. Another hour. Nothing. "It's food," Serwaa tells the fire. "You know it in your gut. Literally." The Codex notes it.
